notes.title: Now in Chinese, Japanese, and Korean
notes.content:
A few months ago, I ported Cogs from a custom C++ engine I wrote in 2008 to Unity. That's made the game easier to maintain and also opened the doors to make it easier to localize to East-Asian languages. I'm happy to announce that today's build makes Cogs available in Chinese, Japanese and Korean and also fixes some of the text rendering bugs in Russian.

As always, feedback is appreciated! If you see bugs or bad translations, let me know by sending feedback to support@lazy8studios.com.

If you want to try a translation without changing the language at the operating system level, just type one of these cheat codes from the main menu:

[list]
[*] English = "langen"
[*] Chinese = "langzh"
[*] Japanese = "langja"
[*] Korean = "langko"
[*] German = "langde"
[*] Spanish = "langes"
[*] French = "langfr"
[*] Italian = "langit"
[*] Dutch = "langnl"
[*] Polish = "langpl"
[*] Portuguese = "langpt"
[*] Russian = "langru"
[/list]
As part of this patch, I also made some minor improvements to shadows and added back more variety to the puzzle frames, which was accidentally dropped during the port to Unity earlier this year.

Happy puzzling!

    Rob Jagnow
    Founder, Lazy 8 Studios

notes.title: Language support is back!
notes.content:
As I ported Cogs from the old 2009 engine to Unity, it was too much to get all to old localization files working at the same time.

I took some time over the last few weeks to completely overhaul the font rendering system, allowing me to offer Cogs in all these languages!

[list]
[*] English
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] Dutch
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[/list]
As part of this change, I've moved all font rendering to use signed distance fields (SDF), which should mean crisper, more legible fonts everywhere.

If your system doesn't automatically detect the language you prefer to use, I built in some "cheat codes" that you can type from any screen to use your language of choice.

[list]
[*] English = "langen"
[*] German = "langde"
[*] Spanish = "langes"
[*] French = "langfr"
[*] Italian = "langit"
[*] Dutch = "langnl"
[*] Polish = "langpl"
[*] Portuguese = "langpt"
[*] Russian = "langru"
[/list]
See a bad translation? Bad font rendering? Don't hesitate to send bug reports to me at support@lazy8studios.com.

  - Rob

notes.title: Cogs Update Released
notes.content: Hey, Mountain Lion users -- thanks for your patience while we worked around some bugs in the OSX 10.8 graphics drivers.  With the newest changes, I've fixed the flickering borders that could sometimes show up in fullscreen mode.  I also modified shadow rendering to bypass a graphics driver bug that was causing a really tragic crash.

notes.title: Cogs Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Cogs have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

By popular demand, we just patched in Steam Cloud support for Cogs! This means that your progress will be tied to your Steam account and transfer automatically between computers, even if you're switching between Mac and PC.

notes.title: What we're up to
notes.content: Hey everybody, First of all, thanks for playing the game! The reaction to the release has been more than positive which is a great relief to us after spending the last year and especially the last few months pushing to get this thing done. I thought I'd drop a general note to let everyone know that we're still alive. Rob and I have been a little quiet as we're both catching up on stuff we'd put aside in the last few months but I'd like to assure you that the Cogs saga is far from finished. Some things we've got in the pipe: - Translations! We've started a Cogs wiki for the main purpose of getting the game in other languages. We're having the major European languages done professionally, however if you speak something other than English and would like to see the game in your native tongue, please feel free to help us out! http://www.lazy8studios.com/wiki/ You may also notice an article in the wiki labeled "Cogs Mods." We've mentioned in a few places that we've included support to make your own custom puzzles. Rob's still writing up the documentation but if this is something you're interested in you can have a look at what he's got already. - Widescreen and Anti-Aliasing support. These are two of the most requested features and we hope to have them added to the game soon. That's all for now, hope you all are enjoying the game. I see a few of you have managed to complete every achievement, to who I would like to say "you're insane." I don't even have every achievement and I freaking helped make this thing! Peace, --Brendan
